about: The Undercroft as the room checks know it (tools/blender/room_checks). Since G2b the checks read the room's numbers from the builder's manifest and the scene (roomcfg.Facts); this file holds only the judged failures and the scene ids allowed in extras.
allowed_ids_note: decision D7: the cellar's single torches stay as objects. Their nodes and lights are named `brand` (cl.brand_*, cl.lt_brand_*), so every name passes the word scan; the lights' and glows' extras keep the scene's own light ids (wdi_light_id, which cc_struct holds to the scene's night lights), and r7_extra takes these three ids out of an extra's value before it scans it

known_fails.why: 323 of the map's 325 walkable tiles can be stood on. (1,9) and (1,10) lie under the crypt stair (the visible flight up to the chapel, decision D6), 0.9 m wide against the west wall from the crypt spawn's tile southward: a flight up stands on its tiles, as the chapel's crypt stair stands on two of the chapel's. A piece of the room covering walkable tiles, as the bedroom's bed does. Listed for the owner (2026-11-22), not yet ruled on.
